findings.label: Orders filter widening
findings.detail: The owner /orders branch now matches user_id OR mobile instead of mobile alone; it can only return a superset of the prior rows, never fewer, and the JSON shape and id-desc ordering are unchanged. Confirm the product intent is 'show all orders I own' (the sensible reading). No code change required.

findings.label: Public cache TTL on /settings and /config
findings.detail: A 30s Cache-Control max-age means admin edits to settings/config/announcement can take up to 30s to appear on already-loaded clients. Matches the stated rarely-changing intent; confirm 30s staleness is acceptable for announcement/store-config edits.

findings.label: Pool fix inert until live .env updated
findings.detail: connection_limit/pool_timeout are only in .env.example; the live .env must get the same params (a manual deploy step) for the pool tuning to take effect. Correctly documented in PERF-FINDINGS DEPLOY.
